message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards applied to incoming data; XML fields are parsed and cast directly (e.g., int(), float()) without any validation of structure or range.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is read from local filesystem paths; no remote sources are fetched, so no checksum verification, signed URLs, or pinned revisions are present or needed—but the control is absent regardless.

No detected label flipping detection: The code loads class labels from a text file and counts samples per class for display purposes, but performs no validation of label values against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and uses no label-noise detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is present anywhere in the data preparation pipeline; samples are loaded and passed directly to the DataLoader.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained models via `initialise_model` with a `pretrained` flag but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify the integrity of the loaded weights.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms (e.g., neural cleanse, gradient anomaly analysis, activation clustering) are present anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, Cleverhans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a separate validation dataset is used, there is no signing/hashing of evaluation data, no explicit isolation enforcement, and no use of multiple independent metrics to cross-validate results.
No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on incoming data before it is passed to the model in any of the visible inference-path code.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks for NaN values, probability bounds, or calibrated thresholds are applied to model outputs anywhere in the visible code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision-based (CNN/LSTM) behaviour recognition model, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
